# SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.3 profile registration and activation-status amendment

Status: **CANDIDATE scientific record; no registration, activation,
evaluation, or object decision is asserted**.

The six status axes below are independent. They apply to the r0.3 generation
of `SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2` and
`SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2` and to every statement about their
paired candidate SCI-VAL records.

| Axis | Current r0.3 candidate truth |
| --- | --- |
| `profile_semantics_state` | `candidate` |
| `scientific_owner_approval_state` | `pending` |
| `registry_registration_state` | `pending` |
| `source_binding_state` | `pending` |
| `activation/evaluability_state` | `unavailable` |
| `object_specific_decision_realization` | `unavailable` |

`SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2` is the proposed owner-governed
aggregate-profile identity for this candidate. After exact owner acceptance,
canonical Registry/source binding, and activation, SCI-VAL may evaluate it for
a requested object. The same generation rule applies to
`SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2`. Candidate bytes and a proposed binding do
not manufacture a realized decision.

The imported uniform coefficient Registry, family, and handoff records and the
original-footprint coordinate boundary retain their exact historical approval
and immutable identities. That historical status does not activate this new
MAP/VAL generation. All affected current numerical routes therefore remain
unavailable for evaluation and have no object-specific decision. No earlier
record or evaluation is revoked, rebound, or relabeled.
